name: Book Haven
Details: Book Haven is an online platform for book lovers to explore, review, and track books across genres. With a user-friendly interface and personalized recommendations, it makes discovering your next favorite read effortless. This project showcases my skills in full-stack web development and creating engaging, user-centric applications.

name: Green Nest
Details: Green Nest is an app for plant enthusiasts to explore and learn about various plants and trees. Users can view detailed information, care tips, and characteristics for each plant, making it easier to nurture and appreciate greenery. This project highlights my skills in full-stack development and creating informative, user-friendly applications.

name: AppForge Applications
Details: AppForge is a platform where users can discover, install, and uninstall applications with ease. It provides a clean and interactive interface to browse featured apps, making software management simple and intuitive. This project demonstrates my skills in full-stack development and building user-friendly, interactive web applications.
